title: Geneva Conventions of 12 August 1949 and Additional Protocols I & II of 8 June 1977
summary: Adoption of the Four Geneva Conventions of 12 August 1949 for the Protection of War Victims, including Common Article 1 (obligation to respect and ensure respect), Common Article 2 (application in international armed conflicts), Common Article 3 (non-international armed conflicts), and Grave Breaches regime.
